_what_this_is: THE STACK-SPECIFIC HALF OF THE VOX VALIDATION HARNESS, in one file.
ci.py is the step ladder: run each family in order, print a positive marker with
a count, name the family that stopped the run. The commands live here.
count_pattern: a regex whose CAPTURED GROUPS are summed to produce the count.
Zero is not a pass — a suite that discovered nothing exits 0 and looks perfect.

families.name: migrations
families._note: conformance lint (harness/migration_lint.py) + local `supabase db reset` replay when the range adds migrations; concludes MIGRATION_LINT_NONE or MIGRATION_REPLAY_OK

families.name: drizzle
families._note: client-migration conformance lint (harness/drizzle_lint.py): append-only, NNNN sequential, journal/migrations.js agreement; concludes DRIZZLE_LINT_NONE or DRIZZLE_LINT_OK (territory expansion 2026-08-18)

families.name: deno_integration
families._note: the Deno live-stack suites, dark until 2026-08-18 (#15/#18/#22's recorded gap); owns its own functions-serve via VoxStack (MOCK_MODE=true, the suites' documented contract), RUN_INTEGRATION=true. pipeline-chain.test.ts is deliberately excluded: it requires hand-seeded TEST_RECORDING_ID/TEST_TENANT_ID fixtures and its chain coverage is superseded by the e2e family's live journey

families.name: native_compile
families._note: iOS simulator compile (no signing) only when the range touches the native surface (ios/ and android/ are gitignored prebuild artifacts); concludes NATIVE_COMPILE_NONE or NATIVE_COMPILE_OK (territory expansion 2026-08-18)

_note: The 'app' is the LOCAL Supabase stack plus `supabase functions serve`.
Fixed ports (single instance per machine) — the dynamic-port rule of the
template does not apply; instead the driver FAILS if another serve owns the
functions gateway, so two runs cannot silently share one environment.
